fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $100,000, uniform for all franchisees. A 5% reduction ($5,000 off) is available for active-duty U.S. military and honorably discharged veterans (must maintain at least 51% ownership; discount must be reimbursed if veteran is no longer an Owner before the 5th anniversary, except death or disability). A 5% reduction is also available to current franchisees of Urban Air Adventure Park and Affiliated Brands in good standing. Multi-unit Development Agreements include the initial franchise fee within the Development Fee (e.g., 1 park = $100,000, 2 parks = $185,000 total at $85,000 each, 3 parks = $260,000 total at ~$75,000-$86,667 each). All fees are fully earned and non-refundable when paid.
raw_excerpt:
When you sign a Franchise Agreement, you will pay us a $100,000 initial franchise fee. Except for the differences described below, the initial franchise fee is uniform for all franchisees.

We offer a 5% reduction of the initial franchise fee and the Development Fee for active-duty United States military and United States veterans that were honorably discharged.

We offer a 5% reduction of the initial franchise fee to current franchisees of Urban Air Adventure Park and Affiliated Brands in good standing when they purchase an Urban Air Adventure Park franchise.
